scenes.say: Pod acting up? Let’s break down a quick troubleshooting kit every engineer should know.
First, get a snapshot of pod status. Next, scan events for error messages. Then, check the logs, especially for failed runs. Finally, verify if your service endpoints are set up right.

scenes.title: Your go-to tools
scenes.say: These commands help you spot stuck pods, read event history, catch crash output, and confirm if your service is routing traffic.

scenes.label: Fast Fix
scenes.sub: describe and logs with previous flag solve most issues
scenes.say: Pro tip: describe and logs with the previous flag fix most problems fast.

scenes.question: What’s the first thing to check?
scenes.right: Start with pod status and events, then read logs.
scenes.say: Interview trap! Don’t jump straight to logs. Always check pod status and events first—then dig into the logs.
